info.title: QA Demo Store API
info.description: API d'entraînement QA (données fictives). Les mêmes routes sont servies dans la page (GitHub Pages, localStorage) et par l'API Node optionnelle (npm run server).

get.summary: Execution context for testers (mode, clock, scenario, versions)

post.summary: Reset all data to a named scenario (keeps the clock setting)
Freeze the clock at a given instant

get.summary: Search, filter, sort and paginate the catalog

post.summary: Post a review (one per customer and product)
Ask to be notified when a sold-out product is back (explicit consent)
Add or remove a product from the wishlist
Authoritative quote computed by the engine (valid 15 minutes)
Place an order from a quote (Idempotency-Key header required)
Cancel an order that has not shipped yet

get.summary: Invoice data (sequential number, VAT breakdown, legal mentions)

post.summary: Withdrawal eligibility and refund amount (14 days)

put.summary: Give or withdraw newsletter consent (proof recorded)

post.summary: Record a visitor cookie choice (pseudonymous proof)

get.summary: Export all my data as JSON (access and portability)

delete.summary: Delete my account (orders kept anonymized for accounting)

patch.summary: Update price (TTC cents), stock or availability
Change an order status (state machine enforced)

get.summary: Revenue, average basket, cancellation and return rates, top products
Products to restock with suggested quantities

post.summary: Apply the retention plan now (anonymize or delete due records)
